figurative_meaning_en: Promotion or advancement in one's job
example_sentences_in_bangla: কঠোর পরিশ্রমের ফলে সে পদোন্নতি পেল।
example_sentences_in_english: He will get a promotion soon.
Due to his hard work, he received a promotion.
note: This is a compound word often used idiomatically in professional contexts in Bengali.
